newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 400 METRES WORLD CHAMPION FREEMAN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 400 METRES WORLD CHAMPION FREEMAN.

text.p: Profile of Cathy Freeman, who won the world women's 400 metres final on Monday.:
Burst into the limelight at the 1994 Commonwealth Games, winning both the 200 and 400 metres and taking silver in the 4x100 metres.
Took silver in the Olympic 400 metres final last year in Atlanta behind Marie-Jose Perec of France, becoming the first aboriginal to win an Olympic medal.
Made a strong start to the world championship final two years ago in Gothenburg, taking the lead and running the first 200 metres in 23.30 seconds before fading to end up fourth.
Emerged as the favourite for this year's race after Perec decided to concentrate on the 200 metres.
